text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The blue sea!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: The scorching sun!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The extraordinary setting of a training 
camp deepens bonds of friendship... 
Something is bound to happen this summer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, those girls are right there 
with them!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hayahide-saaan! Taishin-san, Ticket-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Um, since we're at a training camp anyway! 
Let's deepen the bonds between us 
classmates!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah, that's true. By the way... 
You're in exceptionally high spirits, 
Royce-kun.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's training camp, after all☆ Doesn't it 
just make you feel excited? Right, 
Ticket-san!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Watermelon splitting, pillow 
fights, and fireworks! I'm so excited!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
"No... I don't think I'll have time for 
that this year, though."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Starting with this summer training camp, 
I'm changing my self-production strategy.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"A youthful track alongside BNW―― I'll 
ride the wave of their powerful youth 
drama and weave that very youth into my 
own story!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...Self-producing again? You really do 
one thing after another, huh."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"That sounds so fun! Turbo wants to enjoy 
her youth too!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Then why don't we have a taste of youth 
too? Hmm... maybe run toward the sunset?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That was just because everyone got carried 
away in the heat of the moment with their 
peers. So if we have a get-together to 
reach that point—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce and the others were having 
a blast talking about youthful romantic 
scenarios. Just then—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the tones Royce plays are going to 
become richer and richer, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To bring out her multifaceted tones... You 
are a truly great maestro.
choice_data_list:
Um, could you tell me what you mean by 
that?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
To bring out her multifaceted tones... You 
are a truly great maestra.
choice_data_list:
Um, could you tell me what you mean by 
that?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her words were so unique that I could 
hardly grasp their meaning. She seemed to 
think very highly of us, but... why?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Royce-san's tone is truly multifaceted. It 
is as if she is performing an entire 
orchestra all on her own.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ever-shifting—depending on the time and 
place, she flexibly changes how she 
presents herself."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
She is the only performer on the turf who 
can play such a wide variety of music!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And you are the conductor who draws out 
her new tone, guiding her toward an 
extraordinary melody."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"And you are the conductor who draws out 
her new tone, guiding her toward an 
extraordinary melody."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Their music shows us limitless 
possibilities.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I experience Royce-san's music, a 
new melody begins to overflow from within 
me as well—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I feel like I can reach a music of my 
own, one that even I haven't heard yet."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You all are my guideposts. Please continue 
to perform, unbound by any sheet music.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Trainer, the summer training 
camp has already begun.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Kikuka Sho, we're putting 
our all into our new youth drama route!
